research_question: Does current-state dynamic-obstacle sensing plus risk-aware connectivity scheduling improve direct-local navigation without using future obstacle information?
main_variable: geometric_dynamic observation and risk_aware_connectivity target scheduling
algorithm: Direct Local Adaptive Edge-GAT MAPPO with current-risk task allocation
information_boundary: observation contains only current nearest-particle relative state
allocator uses only current particle positions and current vessel geometry
no future particle trajectory, episode outcome, or sealed test data is read
allocator changes targets only; it does not overwrite actions

evaluation.success_gate: three-seed mean on fixed dynamic validation must be >= 0.85; otherwise report gate failure
